lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four to five horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: A prominent vertical band of elevated pixel intensity intersects with the horizontal rows of spots to form a series of grid-like nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single linear feature runs horizontally across the mid-lateral flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.
